name: slack
title: Slack
description: See your Slack messages in Flowpad.

permission.slack.channels.read.why: Read the channels you are in.

permission.slack.chat.write.why: Post replies as you (or your bot).

permission.slack.files.why: Read the files people share in the channel, and send files (`files:read`, `files:write`).

permission.slack.reactions.why: See the emoji people react with, and react as you (or your bot) (`reactions:read`, `reactions:write`).

permission.slack.conversations.read.why: List and read every conversation you are in — DMs, group DMs, channels (`im:*`, `mpim:*`, `channels:*`, `groups:*`, `users:read`).

channel.label: Channel
channel.hint: Leave empty for everything you are in (Sign in with Slack, or your own app). To read ONE channel as a bot, pick it here or type its ID — the ID is what is stored; a renamed channel keeps it. Several channels? One source per channel.

allowed_senders.label: Allowed senders
allowed_senders.hint: Who may drive the owning agent from this channel — Slack member IDs, one per line. Empty allows nobody.

team_id.label: Workspace
team_id.hint: Learned by Connect from your app's token (auth.test).

user_id.label: You
user_id.hint: Your member ID in that workspace, learned by Connect.
